I need to verify the real name of the character known as "Lolita" in Vladimir Nabokov's novel.

In the novel "Lolita," the titular character's full real name is Dolores Haze. "Lolita" is the nickname given to her by the narrator, Humbert Humbert. The novel famously opens with "Lolita, light of my life, fire of my loins. My sin, my soul. Lo-lee-ta" and goes on to explain the various diminutives of her name (Lo, Lola, Dolly, Dolores).

All three agents have provided the same answer with very high confidence (0.98-1.00), and this answer is correct based on the well-established facts about this famous novel.

Answer: Dolores Haze
Confidence: 0.99
